TEXT: We're done going through the photo album.

Having finished Kuroneko's Napolitan Spaghetti, I 
stare at her cleaning up from behind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: How was the taste?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Ah, it's really delicious. That's the first time I've 
eaten spaghetti this good.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: O-Oh really? I just made it the usual way though...

The nervousness from before faded, Kuroneko 
seemed to have regained her composure as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I'll bring some teacakes.

At that moment, Kuroneko, noticing my cup was 
empty, asked...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Do you want another cup of barley tea?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sure.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Huh? It's empty.

It appeared the teapot on the table was empty, 
too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I'll get more tea then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Now then...
I wonder what's written on the last memo?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Mix this with a beverage and Ruri-nee 
will be [font_size=29]to[/font_size][font_size=26]ta[/font_size][font_size=24]lly[/font_size] happy. Check the back of 
this memo before that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: "This"...? You mean what's inside the small box?

Looks like Ramune tablets, but if you put this in, 
then the flavor would turn weird and it would also 
foam. Gotta be some dumb prank.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
It'll provide some energy for your nightlife♪　Enjoy 
your time together with the entranced Ruri-nee to 
the fullest①

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What the heck...!

"Nightlife", you mean THAT? An aphrodisiac?! Isn't 
this some crazy stuff?!

I've read the back of the memo. But, does it really 
work...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, how careless of me.

Slipping that tablet into her drink like an "accident", 
rather fake if I do say so myself... Somehow I'm 
feeling guilty.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hang on. Shouldn't I have some of this too?

Just in case. Gotta make sure. Prepare for the 
unlikely. I swallowed one of the tablets.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Sorry to keep you waiting. There's only rice 
crackers left, but... Did something happen?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: N-No, nothing at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Really? I brought more tea, so let me know if you 
want any second helpings.

As she stared at me acting all suspicious, Kuroneko 
drank the mixture... I-I wonder what will happen!

Excite- Nah, more like uneasy... I waited for any 
change in her.
